fix: Fixed static-member completion for optional declaration groups, including `App.CHROME` and large `R.string.text_*` resource sets; truncated Ace completion lists are now refreshed with a debounce as the prefix changes

Fixed ordinary large documents being mistaken for very long lines, causing them to switch to plain-text mode and lose JavaScript highlighting, completion, and semantic services; genuinely very long individual lines still use safety mode

feature: Kept the complete source declarations bundled and added selectable AutoJs6 LSP declaration groups: `core` is always enabled, while `android`, `libraries`, `resources`, and `main-app` are disabled by default; selecting `libraries` also enables `android`, and selecting `main-app` also enables `android`, `libraries`, and `resources`

Added the `:app:generateAutoJs6LspDeclarations` Gradle task to validate declarations and generate the five LSP groups and their manifest; normal asset merging invokes it automatically, and external scripts can call it directly
dependency: Upgraded the bundled TypeScript language service and standard library declarations from `4.2.4` to `6.0.3`

feature: Added the standalone Ace editor plugin with plugin ID `ace-editor`, engine `editor`, and variant `ace`
Added discovery through `org.autojs.plugin.INFO` and `org.autojs.plugin.EDITOR` components protected by `org.autojs.permission.PLUGIN`, with Editor API contract 1 and minimum host build `5234`

Added Ace `1.4.12` editing features including undo/redo, search and replace, regex and whole-word search, cursor and selection navigation, line operations, breakpoints, comment toggling, and code formatting
Added built-in JavaScript/TypeScript language services and AutoJs6 type declarations with completion, hover, diagnostics, and signature help plus syntax diagnostics for JSON files
Added incremental text synchronization, CRLF preservation, chunked loading for large text, a lightweight mode for very long lines, and IME adaptation
Added themes and display settings plus font download, caching, installation, and removal with signed catalog and file integrity verification
Added WebView runtime health monitoring, heartbeat detection, and host native editor fallback notifications

Added localized plugin metadata, README, and changelog content for Spanish, French, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Hong Kong Traditional Chinese, and Taiwan Traditional Chinese
